---
applyTo: "**/*.md,docs/**"
---

# Documentation rules

- Write short sentences. One idea per paragraph.
- Every design decision records: choice, reason, trade-off.
- Use tables only for comparisons. Use lists for steps.
- README sections in order: what it is, how it works, how to build and run, results, limitations.
- Benchmark numbers must include hardware, build type, method, and p50/p99/p99.9.
- Never document features that are not built. Mark future work explicitly.
- Keep `docs/design.md` in sync when a decision changes.
- Code blocks must be runnable as written.
